name: pig-knockback
comment: WP-2.2. Stone platform y = 60 over -8..8 with the one-high rim; pig 0 at (0.5, 61, 0.5), pig 1 at (2.5, 61, 0.5). The attack op's direct branch, target.attackEntityFrom(attacker, damage) (EntityLiving.java:307-365), on pig 1: t=5 by pig 0, 2 (knockBack away from pig 0, hurtTime 10, the 20-tick resistance window starts); t=8 by pig 0, 2 (in the window, not above the window's first hit: false); t=9 by pig 0, 3 (in the window: 1 point, no knock-back); t=20 by pig 0, 2 (window over: full hit and knock-back); t=35 by itself, 1 (the attacker at the same position: the Math.random() direction loop); t=50 with no attacker, 1 (Math.random() attackedAtYaw, no knock-back); t=65 by pig 0, 5 (dies: death sound, onDeath, dropFewItems of raw porkchops; deathTime to 20, then setEntityDead); t=70 by pig 0, 2 on the dying pig (health <= 0: false). rng_state and entity_state every tick.
